purpose.intro: **What.** The universe of standardised value types: BCP 47 locales, IANA timezones, E.164 phone numbers, ISO 3166-1 countries, ISO 4217 currencies. Tuples + types + validators + OS-detection helpers. **How.** One subfolder per domain. Each exports a value tuple (`as const`), a derived TS type, a Zod schema (or `Intl`-based runtime validator), metadata, a `systemResolvable` flag, and — when resolvable — a `detectSystemValue()` helper. **Why.** Products need consistent, verifiable value sets. Having one source of truth per standard (not hand-rolled tuples per consumer) keeps validation, UI dropdowns, and DB enums in sync.
